description: RAWRIS is the rural agricultural water resources information system of the Korea Rural Community Corporation. The portal read on 2026-09-28 offers a search of agricultural production infrastructure, information on rural water use and on rural water quality, map-based real-time measurements, and statistical yearbooks on the maintenance of agricultural production infrastructure, with 2023 and 2024 editions announced. Its notice board posts water level control and release notices for large estuary reservoirs such as Asan, Namyang, Ganwol and Sapgyo lakes, the latest dated September 2026. Coverage is South Korea's rural water systems. Access is free on the web; no licence or bulk download was read. Caveats: the site is in Korean, the infrastructure search and real-time pages were not opened, and what types of facility are listed, such as reservoirs, pumping stations or canals, was not confirmed. It supports irrigation and drought studies, such as tracking reservoir releases and water levels during a dry season, or flood studies of estuary reservoir operations. No related Korean irrigation record is catalogued.
